title: Google Research DP-SGD Clipping: In-Place Fast Gradient Norm, Ghost Norm & FFT Dispatch for CNNs
author: repo-triad-forge

edges.description: Subproject dp_sgd_clipping in snapshot google-research-master (archive snapshot, non-git); arXiv:2205.10683
Shares memory-bounded backward/gradient tensor reformulation without full intermediate materialization

claims.assertion: fast_cnn_grad_norm.py implements three incomparable per-sample 1D-CNN squared L2 gradient-norm algorithms without materializing unfolded per-sample Jacobians: in_place_fast_grad_norm (np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view + np.tensordot), in_place_ghost_norm (double output-index Frobenius inner product), and in_place_norm_fft (circulant-matrix convolution via np.fft.fft/ifft on strided padded partial gradients).

grad_norm_computation_selector estimates regime-dependent asymptotic runtimes (fft, ghost, fast_grad) weighted by empirical constants (20, 6, 4, 3, 2) and delegates to _select_method (L113-L154) honoring memory_efficient_implementation_required.

distilled_learning: Avoid O(output_dim * kernel * channels) per-sample Jacobian materialization in differentially private CNN training by dispatching across in-place sliding-window, ghost-norm Gramian, and FFT circulant estimators according to layer shape and memory constraints.
